𝙈𝙖𝙥𝙨 features Brian Haran (Ama Divers, Filthybirds; engineer on numerous records) handling electronics/oscillators/tapeloops, Nick Vanbuskirk on sax (Panes, Kill the Buddha, bedroom division, and countless others), along with Tyler Monroe behind the drums (plays with too many people to count). This project is 100% improv—noisy ambient colliding with avant jazz. brian.s.haran likewindowpanes _tyler.monroe_ 

𝙇𝙪𝙠𝙚 𝙎𝙘𝙝𝙣𝙚𝙞𝙙𝙚𝙧 is a Nashville based pedal steel guitarist who has worked with a variety of artists including Margo Price, Orville Peck, S.G. Goodman, William Tyler, and Futurebirds. His debut solo album of ambient New Age music created entirely on pedal steel, ‘Altar of Harmony,’ was released by Third Man Records in 2020. His new EP ‘For Dancing In Quiet Light’ is out now via Leaving Records. lukefromnashville 

𝙎𝙖𝙖𝙥𝙖𝙩𝙤 is the music project of upstate New York–based sound artist Brendan Principato, who weaves manipulated field recordings with lush electronic soundscapes exploring ecology and music. He has held residencies with the National and Alaska State Park Services, including 2023 near Juneau and 2022 on Fire Island. His recordings have been named Best Ambient on Bandcamp, and his live performances include collaborations with Laraaji, Don Slepian, Patricia Wolf, and Green-House. saapato

events.title: 🎨 Advance Base & Moontype with Panes
events.description:
advance_base & moontypo are coming back to Greensboro with local support from likewindowpanes on Wednesday, February 25th 👾🎶🎹

Doors at 7pm and music at 8pm // $12 suggested 

This is going to be a really sweet show. We’re super thrilled to have these folks back in Greensboro. If you missed Advance Base for his winter tour in 2024 or Moontype last summer, this is your chance to see them both with Greensboro’s own, Panes. 

Advance Base is the melancholic soft rock recording project of Chicago, IL singer/songwriter Owen Ashworth (formerly of Casiotone for the Painfully Alone). Using a two-handed arsenal of electric piano, Omnichord, samplers, effect pedals & drum machines, Ashworth builds minimalist, heavy-hearted, nostalgia-obsessed ballads around his conversational baritone. The warm, electronic sound of Advance Base has been described as “lo-fi,” “depressed” & “weirdly uplifting.” Advance Base released Horrible Occurrences in 2024.

Moontype is songwriter Margaret McCarthy’s dreamworld come to life. Based in Chicago, Illinois, the band features Emerson Hunton on drums, and Joe Suihkonen and Andrew Clinkman on guitar. Quiet emotions that McCarthy explores with her bass become, with the band, as large and as musically complex as a mood itself: cathartic, angsty, and unmet. Moontype released their debut album, Bodies of Water, in 2021 to critical acclaim.

panes is minimal introspective music with an engaging, dreamy listlessness. ever careening toward some kind of undiscovered self epiphany.

events.title: 🎨 Death Circle
events.description:
𝔇𝔢𝔞𝔱𝔥 ℭ𝔦𝔯𝔠𝔩𝔢, 𝔱𝔬𝔡𝔞𝔶 𝔣𝔯𝔬𝔪 5 𝔱𝔬 7 𝔓𝔐 

So many of us are carrying a lot right now. Personal losses, collective grief, the ache of what is happening in the world, and the grief we feel for our more-than-human kin and planet. We were never meant to carry any of this alone. What does it mean to live and die consciously? This circle is an offering to unburden ourselves in shared community and, in doing so, perhaps find more spaciousness and imaginative possibilities. 

Together we will co-create a sacred space to remember that these tender conversations about death, grief, cycles of change, and all of our connections in this web of existence once lived at the center of our communities. They are an integral part of our collective wellbeing. 

Death Circle is not a therapeutic setting or a grief support group, but an invitation to be present with one another as we explore these topics and reconnect more deeply with ourselves, each other, and the world around us. We welcome your curiosities, stories, questions, as well as your silence. There is no pressure to speak. All of it belongs 🖤

Our hope is that this offering fosters clarity, nurtures care, and deepens our relational intimacy. 

Death Circle will be held on the last Sunday of every month, from 5-7pm. We’ll have coffee and donuts, but feel free to bring your own snacks or any comfort items that support you.

We look forward to seeing you there — 
Joshua & Bri

events.title: 🎨 DAGGERTEETH
events.description:
DAGGERTEETH TOMORROW TOMORROW TOMORROW.
.
ARE Y'ALL PUMPED CUZ WE CAN'T WAIT TO OPEN OUR DOORS TO YOU TOMORROW!
.
Teeth don't lie. They bite, they tear, they mark what they touch.

Traditional printmaking techniques meet zine culture's raw urgency. Punk aesthetics slash through the white cube aesthetic and screams to be heard.

Every piece here carries evidence of hands—ink rolled, paper pressed, screens burned, images carved. The tactility of making things physical in a digital age. These works don't apologize for their rough edges. They weaponize them.

DAGGERTEETH celebrates artists who create outside institutional approval, distribution systems built on photocopiers and kitchen tables, aesthetics born from necessity and defiance. The underground made visible.

Sharp work for sharp teeth.

**February 21, 2026 | 5PM-8PM**

Irving Park Art & Frame

2800 Lawndale Dr. Ste 107, Greensboro, NC

events.title: 🤝 Greensboro Revolutionary Socialists Special Meeting: Borders are prisons and prisons are borders
events.description:
Greensboro Revolutionary Socialists would like to invite you to join us this Monday, February 10 at 7pm at 1333 Grove St for a special meeting, featuring a talk by organizer Kristen Godfrey on their article, "Borders are prisons and prisons are borders" with a discussion to follow.

*

"The way working-class people experience borders all over the world is tied to the theft of land and surplus value. Settler-colonialism’s life source is criminality and illegality, which is why we must be anti-capitalist abolitionists, developing a critical analysis of how imperialists’ tactics work to divide us."

*

Tell us how this new context impacts you. Let's think about how we can resist together.
 Group of revolutionary socialists in Greensboro, NC and members of Tempest Collective @tempest_mag

events.title: 🤝 Trial of Alejandro Bodart

Bodart’s trial is not only about Bodart, it is an international trend to criminalize any expression of solidarity with Palestine, while the State of Israel has murdered over 180,000 Palestinians. Greensboro Revolutionary Socialists stand in solidarity with Bordart and all those across the world resisting genocide. #absolucionparabodart

events.title: 🎵 Sunday Night Birthday Finale: ISH K
events.description:
Our Sunday night birthday finale headed by ISH K

ISH K is a Melbourne-based electronic artist known for his immersive blend of psytrance and progressive psychedelic music. With releases on PsyFeature, Odiva Records, Synk87 and Spin Twist Records, his sound combines driving basslines, hypnotic grooves and intricate psychedelic sound design.
A regular on Australia’s festival circuit, ISH K has performed at Esoteric Festival, Rabbits Eat Lettuce, Blossom Festival, Rainbow Spirit, Bohemian Beatfreaks, Dangerous Goods XXL and AURA. Internationally, he’s taken his sound to Universo Paralello in Brazil and NYX Festival in Mexico, delivering powerful, emotional dancefloor journeys to psychedelic communities around the world.

events.title: 🎵 Desmond Myers and Aaron Rizzo
events.description:
Tonight, Wednesday the 5th!
Doors at 7pm
Show at 8pm

Desmond Myers is an Atlanta-based singer-songwriter and producer. His music is bolstered by a smooth understated tenor voice, moody colorful arrangements with earnest lyrics. Whether behind a guitar or a synthesizer, his music is full of clever restraint, energy and mood. 

After spending a decade living in France he was exposed to the indie-funk/disco scene and it left an unmistakable mark on his music. His album Shadowdancer (recorded in France) reflects this sound and it’s breakout single “Playing with Fire” has been streamed over 4 million times.

 In summer 2026, he’s releasing his third album “Superdomestic” with the single “Balloon” along with dates along the east coast. 

Aaron Rizzo is an independent rock artist from Rochester, New York whose original work has fostered acclaim from listeners all over the globe. His music has appeared on television shows such as Shameless, Black-Ish and in a T-Mobile ad. In the spring of 2025, Rizzo appeared on NBC’s hit television show The Voice, where he worked closely with Canadian singer Michael Bublé.

A guitar player by nature and a singer by trade, Aaron Rizzo writes, records and produces music for himself and others in Atlanta, Georgia where he is based. It’s here that he has sharped his toolset, making him a Swiss Army knife of a musician that can thrive in just about any environment.

To date, Rizzo has recorded four full-length solo albums that eloquently showcase his diversity as an original artist. Each one of his records explores a different corner of his ability, all with two common denominators — prolific songwriting and articulate guitar work. In addition to his own catalog, he has recorded and produced countless songs for other artists. He has composed original scores for two short films, one of which that went on to win Best Score at the Sick ’N Wrong Film Festival.

events.description:
Today, Saturday the 8th!
Doors at 2:30pm
Show at 3pm

Experience the spellbinding artistry of Hiroya Tsukamoto / a master of fingerstyle guitar and evocative storytelling that transcends cultural boundaries. 
 
Praised by Acoustic Guitar Magazine for his “delicate, fluid, and beautifully details” style, Hiroya’s music weaves intricate melodies with poetic narratives, creating an unforgettable, soul-stirring performance.

Hiroya Tsukamoto is a Japanese-born fingerstyle guitarist who moved to the United States in 2000 to attend the Berklee College of Music. Needless to say, he’s not only a dizzyingly agile fingerpicker, but a soulful and transcendent performer, with compositions that combine instrumental guitar work with lyrical performance and spoken stories from his life. 

Tsukamoto has been recognized for his talents on stages such as at Blue Note in New York City, NHK Television,  International Storytelling Center and United Nations, and by scoring second place at the International Fingerstyle Guitar Championship both in 2018 and 2022.

events.title: 🎵 Irata
events.description:
Tonight, August the 8th!
Doors at 7pm
Show at 8pm

Since its 2007 genesis at the hands of founding members Jon Case and Jason Ward, Irata has mutated relentlessly. Through four previous records, the band has never sat idly in any specific style, while maintaining a signature mesmerizing, grinding pulse between bass and drums that permeates an enigmatic vision of heavy rock. After releasing ‘Tower’ in 2019 as a four-piece, Irata is once again a trio, and continues to push forward into new sonic territories.

On ‘Human,’ the band is building on the structures that have created some of its enduring favorites — namely, thundering bass riffs, hypnotic drums, and grandiose choruses. They do not sacrifice expression for refinement, but manage to have it both ways. Their progression is evident in the patience with which “Altar” leads off, a melodic confidence that overarches the eight included songs, and the atmospheres in pieces like “Slipped” (see “pulse…” above) and the expansive finale “Daystar,” but none of ‘Human’ is so overblown as to give up its organically dynamic nature.

And perhaps in an era marked by the advent of machine-made art, ‘Human’ can be as much a statement of purpose as a declaration of self. In any case, with this collection of songs, Irata’s focus on vocal melody and intricate riffing distinguish them from a crowded underground sphere. The record moves as two sides of one image, opening with reflections of a final chapter, and closing with reflections of a new beginning through transformation; a story being told as it’s lived. What could be more human than that?

‘Human’ was recorded with longtime friends Hunter Allen and Adam Joyce of The Bronzed Chorus at Amplified Acres in Liberty, NC, and mixed by J. Robbins at The Magpie Cage in Baltimore, MD.

events.title: 🎵 Treee City
events.description:
This Saturday the 15th!
9pm - 2am

Deeply embedded in North Carolina’s thriving electronic music scene, Treee City is a Durham-based DJ and producer whose dynamic presence has left an indelible mark on dance floors and festivals alike. As a founding member of Durham’s iconic Party Illegal (https://partyillegal.com/) soundsystem, he’s helped cultivate a vibrant underground culture. He has releases on Raund Haus and Maison Fauna have showcased his talent for crafting irresistible grooves.
Treee City’s performances are a testament to his versatility and energy, with appearances at premier festivals like Moogfest, Hopscotch, and Slingshot. He’s shared stages with the likes of Sylvan Esso (https://www.sylvanesso.com/), Steve Aoki (https://steveaoki.com/), Washed Out (https://www.facebook.com/washed.out/), and Daedelus (https://www.facebook.com/Daedelusmusic/), solidifying his reputation as a powerhouse performer. His debut album, “Good Job (https://raundhaus.bandcamp.com/album/good-job)“, released last November on Raund Haus Records, was hailed as “something special…filled with dance-floor heaters” (Indy Week (https://indyweek.com/)).
Beyond the studio and stage, Treee City continues to build community through music. He organizes “Blends With Friends“, a biweekly DJ open decks and music meetup at The Pinhook (https://thepinhook.com/), and “Moodboard“, a monthly club night at Rubies (httpshttps://rubiesnc.com/) in collaboration with Mamis and the Papis (https://www.facebook.com/mamisandthepapis/).
Whether he’s curating a crowd or dropping his signature sound, Treee City is a force that pushes boundaries and elevates the electronic scene in North Carolina and beyond.

events.title: 🎵 Daniel Ayers, Sounds of North Carolina
events.description:
Today, Sunday the 16th!
Doors at 1pm 
Show at 2pm

The ‘Boro Sessions proudly presents “Daniel Ayers, Sounds of North
Carolina” a seated, listening room concert on Sunday afternoon, August 16,
2:00-4:00pm / doors open at 1:00pm (location: 221 Summit Ave,
Greensboro, NC, the Flat Iron). Tickets are $20 plus taxes and fees in
advance/ $25 plus taxes and fees day of show. 

A tenth-generation North Carolinian, Daniel draws inspiration from NC
songwriting greats like Bruce Piephoff and David Childers, absorbing the
stories, sounds, and soul of the Old North State. As co-host of The
Hometown Holler podcast, Daniel has built a devoted following by
celebrating all things North Carolina, connecting audiences across the state
and far beyond its borders. What began as a hobby to give voice to the
untold stories of local community issues has transformed into a podcast with
more than 60 guests and millions of views. Guests have included Josh Stein,
Pat McCrory, Roy Cooper, Anita Earls, and numerous journalists. Daniel
studied history at Roanoke College and taught both history and civics classes
when he returned to North Carolina.
Whether he’s strumming an original tune or singing an old-time murder
ballad, Daniel Ayers sounds like home!!
The venue sells beer, wine, spirits, and sodas. FREE parking: available in
the lot across the street, in the gravel lot across the street from the main
lot, as well as behind the Greensboro Historical Museum.

events.description:

Kristy Cox is a commanding presence in both the Australian and American bluegrass scenes, celebrated for her elegant, heartfelt, and deeply authentic approach to the genre. Often hailed as the “Queen of Bluegrass,” she first rose to prominence in Australia’s country music world before capturing U.S. audiences with multiple Billboard-topping bluegrass releases.

Fronting a powerhouse trio, Kristy delivers a thrilling mix of hard-driving bluegrass, country, folk, and Americana, anchored by dazzling musicianship and rich, soul-stirring harmonies. Rooted in tradition yet bursting with fresh energy, their performances are equal parts electrifying and joyful, winning over audiences wherever they go.

events.title: 🤝 Downtown Neighborhood Association First Meeting
events.location: The Crown at the Carolina Theatre
events.description:
CALLING ALL DOWNTOWN RESIDENTS! 🗣️🌃

Over the past four months, DGI staff have been meeting with downtown residents, property managers, City Council members, and other downtown management nonprofits to help develop the new Downtown Neighborhood Association. 
 
Our first meeting is August 12th at 5:30 p.m. at The Crown at the Carolina Theatre, where we’ll hear directly from downtown residents about what they want to see from the association and what matters most to them as people who live downtown.

The Downtown Neighborhood Association is resident-focused and designed specifically to give downtown residents a space to connect, share their experiences, raise concerns, and help shape the future of downtown living.

If you live downtown, we want to hear from you. Come be part of the conversation and help shape what this new association can become.

events.title: 🎨 Garden of Corporeal Fantasy
events.description:
Thank you to everyone who joined us in celebrating the reception Garden of Corporeal Fantasy by Victoria Mercado-Lues

The exhibition is still open until 5pm — step inside before it closes

************************
NOW OPEN @ GPS
Garden of Corporeal Fantasy
MFA Thesis Exhibition
by Victoria Mercado-Lues

Exhibition: April 21 - 25, 2026
Reception: Friday, April 24th, 6-8p

Gallery Open Hours:
Tuesday - Friday 12-5p
Saturday, 2-5p

Brightly saturated and fantastical, Garden of Corporeal Fantasy explores the meeting of nature and flesh in oil paintings and ceramics. With invented creatures and visceral biological imagery, the works reframe the gaze towards the bodily through a lens of wonder — a less punitive lens than the centuries-long and still recurring traditions of bodies as commodified, objectified, or sinful.

This exhibition addresses our discomfort surrounding the body by combining it with the godly imposing presence of the landscape, like waterfalls and billowing clouds. In this combination, the work is imbued with a devotional, almost sacred quality, borrowing visuals of the holy and filling it with the biological. The sticky, hairy, fleshy becomes something worth staring at with open fascination, the same way we are in awe of exotic plants, or deep-sea creatures, illuminating the sublime inherent in the corporeal.

events.title: 🎨 Homebody MFA Thesis Exhibition
events.description:
Thank you to everyone who joined us for the reception of Homebody by Kathryn Hood!🥂

The exhibition is still open until 5pm — don’t miss out on experiencing Homebody

************************
NOW OPEN @ GPS
Homebody

MFA Thesis Exhibition
by Kathryn Hood

Exhibition: April 28 - May 2, 2026
Reception: Friday, May 1st, 6-8p

Gallery Open Hours:
Tuesday - Friday 12-5p
Saturday, 2-5p

Homebody is an exhibition of collages and sculptures in which Kathryn Hood carves her perceptions of tense muscles into paper and upholstery foam. She embraces the body-mind connection, an essential tool for self-understanding, as she houses ungrounded avatars within handmade paper and muscular furnishings outside of formal traditions. Hood composes the interior feelings of ideas & emotions with the exterior feeling of tension. This duality of perception reflects the disparate nature of themes explored, such as femininity, domesticity, and the performance of identity.

Homebody is the residence of textured perceptions. This space is an act of resensitization.

events.title: 🎨 GPS Student Residency Program: Studio Practice
events.description:
MEET MACY ✨ Current Artist in Residence, as part of the GPS Student Residency Program | Summer Studios: Arts on Site! ✨

About Macy macyjart 
Macy James (BFA Sculpture & Ceramics) will explore various materials that she has yet to try, though has long wanted to. Within this residency, Macy plans to work with more accessible material specifically, in addition to those she is accustomed to, like found and second-hand goods sourced from local places - materials that do not require large shops or expensive tools. Another material interest is found wood, like driftwood, to experiment with wood carving or wood burning alongside bead and wire sculptures, which she presently has no experience working with. The hope is that this will help her develop a healthy habit of creating art with widely accessible materials and make her an overall more multifaceted artist.

About the Student Residency Program:
Designed to support UNCG undergraduate student artists (BA + BFA) striving to develop, adapt, and/or reinvent their creative process and to promote artistic growth and development, artists are afforded two-weeks of uninterrupted research and development, coupled with financial support and public presentational platforms to share their creative work.

Elissa Ukhueligbe (BFA Painting) plans to expand their practice through video and sound. The proposed idea is to animate photos into video and projections, mimicking a low “frames per second.” Using film, photos, drawings, or smaller paintings, they would mix video/sound with traditional art. Another material interest is found wood, like driftwood, to experiment with wood carving or wood burning alongside bead and wire sculptures, which she presently has no experience working with. The hope is that this will help her develop a healthy habit of creating art with widely accessible materials and make her an overall more multifaceted artist.

About the Student Residency Program:
Designed to support UNCG undergraduate student artists (BA + BFA) striving to develop, adapt, and/or reinvent their creative process and to promote artistic growth and development, artists are afforded two-weeks of uninterrupted research and development, coupled with financial support and public presentational platforms to share their creative work.

events.title: 🤝 Unboxed: Art Beyond the Museum
events.description:
For nearly 70 years, ncma.winstonsalem has connected our community to contemporary art through inspiring exhibitions, educational programs, and cultural experiences. While the museum undergoes exciting capital improvements throughout 2026, it’s returning to where it all began—downtown Winston-Salem.

From July 16 through August 30, experience Unboxed: Art Beyond the Museum, the inaugural exhibition in NCMA Winston-Salem’s new downtown art space. Admission is free and open to the public.

Unboxed brings together artists who have contributed to the Museum’s Portable Gallery, an education initiative that places original works by North Carolina artists directly into schools across the state. Last year alone, the program connected more than 2,000 students with contemporary art.

Featuring artists at a variety of career stages, the exhibition explores themes of place, identity, and imagination through diverse subjects, materials, and artistic techniques that reflect the richness of North Carolina itself.

Whether you’re a longtime art lover or simply looking for something new to experience downtown, this is the perfect opportunity to step inside Winston-Salem’s newest creative space and celebrate the power of art to connect our community. 🎨✨

📍 400 W. 4th St. Ste 130

events.location: Main Stage, LeBauer Park, Downtown Greensboro
events.description:
HEADLINER ANNOUNCEMENT

Greensboro, this one is an absolute LEGEND.

PURINA CHOW

Over 40 YEARS of entertaining audiences. A legendary comedy drag queen. A long-term HIV/AIDS survivor. An activist who has spent DECADES raising funds for HIV/AIDS care and local community support right here in North Carolina.

Purina Chow is colorful, hilarious, and unapologetically herself, a comedy queen through and through. And she carries something powerful with her every time she takes the stage: her memorial pearl necklaces. Each pearl represents a soul lost to HIV/AIDS, friends, idols, and those who died silently with no one to remember them. It is one of the most moving tributes in our community.

She is a living reminder of grace, strength, and courage, and she’s bringing all of it to our Main Stage.

It was the largest indie craft fair in Greensboro up until 2020 when the pandemic happened. Slowly but surely I have been coming back to event production and last year was the start of this when GSOZF came back. events.title: 🌈 Miss Gay North Carolina America Pageant
events.description:
👑 Tonight, One More of Our Queens Becomes a “Forever”! 👑
Tonight, our very own Malayia Chanel Iman (malayiachaneliman)  takes the stage to crown her successor as Miss Gay North Carolina America!

💖 Chemistry Nightclub could not be prouder of Malayia and the incredible reign she has had over the past year. Your grace, talent, dedication, and representation have made us so proud to call you one of our own. We love you, and hope you have an absolutely amazing step-down! 👑

🌟 To all of tonight's contestants:
We wish each and every one of you an incredible pageant experience! While only one contestant will take home the crown tonight, every one of you has already shown the talent, drive, heart, and determination it takes to wear this title.  And honestly... we can't pick just one to cheer for! So many of you are part of the Chemistry family. Just know that Chemistry is incredibly proud to continue working with so many and would be honored to have you represent this title!

👑 CHEMISTRY'S INCREDIBLE LEGACY
We have to take a moment to recognize the remarkable representation our house cast has brought to this pageant! Chemistry Nightclub's house cast divas have won the last FIVE out of SIX competitions! If you count our extended drag family of performers, Of the past 15 reigns, 10 have brought it home! 
 👑  In no particular order: Vivian Vaughn, Paris Nicole Brooks-Bonet, Giselle Cassidy Carter, Saniya Chanel Iman, Aria Russo, Chloe Cassidy, Ariel Nicole Night Addams, Emory Starr, Kiara Mel, Jamie Monroe, Kirby Kolby, Devida, and now, Malayia Chanel Iman. 
We honestly couldn't be prouder of the level of talent and excellence our entertainers continue to bring to the stage. This legacy is something truly special, and we are honored to have watched these incredible performers represent Chemistry and Miss Gay NC America with such pride and excellence!

👑 Malayia, as you enjoy the rest of this very special day, please know that although previous commitments prevented us from being there with you tonight, the entire Chemistry Nightclub family is cheering for you from Greensboro! 📣
👑 Once a queen, always a queen, and forever a Chemistry Diva! 🌈
 Greensboro's LGBTQ+ nightclub
